result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: a restaurant card is visibly cut off at the bottom of the screen, and a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal list.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, showing only the top portion of the card with no clear indication to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrollable content area ends above the bottom navigation so cards are fully visible, or add visual padding/scroll hint to indicate more content below.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol...' and is partially off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths within the horizontal scroll container or display the full restaurant name on a second line to avoid awkward truncation.
